svg.title: Contact distance against the exact answer, Achilles and MuJoCo
svg.desc: Each dot is one random pair of shapes (sphere, capsule or box, all six combinations, 1795 pairs), from 0.35 overlapping to 0.3 apart. Horizontal: exact signed distance between the two surfaces, computed independently. Vertical: the distance each engine reports. Every Achilles dot lies on the diagonal (largest error 5e-5). MuJoCo matches for sphere and capsule pairs but is off the diagonal for 86 pairs involving boxes: separated box pairs and deeply overlapping capsule-box pairs.
svg.text: MuJoCo off the line: 86 box pairs
